titleZh: 磊的日记:第一个下雪天
goalZh: 会读一篇按时间顺序写的日记,说出发生了什么和作者的感受
canDoZh: 能读懂一篇写过去一天的日记,按时间顺序说出发生了什么、作者有什么感受

newItems.noteZh: have a snowball fight(打雪仗);snowball 是“雪球”。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Today was my first snow day in Seattle!
lines.zh: (磊的日记)今天是我在西雅图第一次碰上下雪停课!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: In the morning, Ethan woke me up. Classes were canceled!
lines.zh: 早上伊森把我叫醒,课取消了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We went outside with Sofia and built a snowman.
lines.zh: 我们和索菲亚一起出去,堆了一个雪人。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Our snowman was in front of the building. He had Ethan's hat!
lines.zh: 我们的雪人就在楼前,还戴着伊森的帽子!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: In the afternoon, we had a big snowball fight on campus.
lines.zh: 下午我们在校园里打了一场大雪仗。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Ethan is from LA. He was so excited!
lines.zh: 伊森是洛杉矶人,他兴奋极了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Sofia is from Mexico. It was her first snow, too.
lines.zh: 索菲亚来自墨西哥,这也是她第一次见到雪。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: At night, it was really cold, but I was happy.
lines.zh: 晚上特别冷,可我很开心。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: In Chengdu, it doesn't snow a lot.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: So I took a lot of pictures and texted them to Grandma.
lines.zh: 所以我拍了很多照片,发给了奶奶。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: She texted me: 'So beautiful! Wear a hat!'

options: 伊森叫醒了磊,课取消了
索菲亚打电话叫磊出去

questions.prompt: 磊为什么拍了很多照片发给奶奶?
options: 奶奶想看西雅图的校园
questions.explainZh: In Chengdu, it doesn't snow a lot. So I took a lot of pictures and texted them to Grandma.

grammar.titleZh: 日记:按时间顺序讲一天
grammar.bodyZh: 写日记、讲过去的一天,用一般过去时(第 8 单元):was / were,规则动词加 -ed(texted),不规则动词要单独记(wake → woke、go → went、build → built、have → had、take → took)。用 In the morning… / In the afternoon… / At night… 把一天串起来,读的人一下就能跟上。注意:现在也成立的事实还用一般现在时:Ethan is from LA. / In Chengdu, it doesn't snow a lot.。

examples.text: In the morning, Ethan woke me up.
At night, it was really cold, but I was happy.
examples.zh: 晚上特别冷,可我很开心。
